scope: Palestine medical discovery — Al-Quds University Doctor of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Al-Quds University's current Doctor of Medicine page describes a six-year programme with a three-year Basic Medical Sciences phase and three-year Clinical Medical Sciences phase, requiring at least 263 credit hours.

The programme states that clinical training is based on clerkships in affiliated hospitals; the faculty page states that it does not own a teaching hospital and is affiliated with local hospitals for clinical training, without listing current sites.

Al-Quds says its Medicine faculty accepts students under university and Palestinian Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research rules, but the programme page does not provide a live admission calendar or complete entry checklist.

holdReasons: No current fees, mandatory charges, live admissions timetable or complete international-applicant route was located.
Teaching language, recognised-programme status, accommodation, scholarships/loans, student support and detailed current entry requirements are not verified.
No current named hospital partners, clinical capacity or placement-continuity evidence was located; general affiliation must not become a placement guarantee.
nextAction: Obtain current Doctor of Medicine admissions and fee information plus named clinical-partner and programme-recognition evidence before considering a payload.
